Grounding: The printed output is 800. They claim 800. Supported.

Overreach: No causal claim, just count. Fine.

Unacknowledged data problems: There is note that patient_id duplicates but they handled. Also note that there are 93 -999 baseline values but they said not affect count. That's fine. No other issues.

False premise: No false premise.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, no issues.
